newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets quiet as bids gap lower.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets quiet as bids gap lower.

text.p: Prices for raw cotton held steady in a European cotton market that appeared to reach stalemate, trade sources said.
The limited amount of enquiry in circulation was pitched too low to persuade cotton sellers to trade, especially given the absence of even a whisper of fresh fundamental news, they said.
Central Asian and West African cottons attracted the greatest interest but there were no significant contracts reported, one industry monitor said.
